rationale: Review 2026-11-12T21:11:56Z to 2026-11-12T21:16:36Z UTC. All cited text files re-hashed with one script against their recorded text_sha256 and every source_fingerprints entry; all matched. cruden.py number search (snapshot 28504e0c..., 49,073 readable sources) run for the order. Identity: held FR text (73 FR 60605-60607) prints Executive Order 13476 of October 9, 2008, Facilitation of a Presidential Transition. Basis: read the whole order; sec. 4(d) 'Unless extended by the President, this order shall expire on February 20, 2009.' The sunset covers the whole order. Sec. 4(a) superseding EO 13176 is a spent command acting on another order, not a continuing command of EO 13476; sec. 4(b)-(c) are general provisions. Extension/earlier end: cruden found only the order's FR text and its FR-citer copy; no extension, amendment or revocation is held, and the single history observation (cross-reference to EO 13467, supersession of EO 13176) does not act on EO 13476. No savings. Ended on its own terms on 2009-02-20. Accept.
